License Exception STA may not be used for any item in this entry to any of the destinations listed in Country Group A:6 (See Supplement No.1 to part 740 of the EAR).
List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及某些相关零件、部件、配件和附属装置（包括容量超过50发的弹匣），见USML第I类。(2) 半自动步枪见ECCN 0A506。(3) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507。(4) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”见ECCN 0A502。(5) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(6) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见本条目.d、.x和.y。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and certain related parts, components, accessories, and attachments (including magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds). (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols. (4) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (5) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (6) See .d, .x, and .y of this entry for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.
Related Definitions: N/A.
Items:

text.zh: a. 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的非自动且非半自动枪支。
text.en: a. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.
Note 1 to paragraph 0A501.a:

text.zh: ‘组合式手枪’受ECCN 0A501.a管制。‘组合式手枪’（亦称组合枪）至少具有一根膛线枪管和一根滑膛枪管（通常为霰弹枪式枪管）。
text.en: 'Combination pistols' are controlled under ECCN 0A501.a. A 'combination pistol' (a.k.a., a combination gun) has at least one rifled barrel and at least one smoothbore barrel (generally a shotgun style barrel).
Note 2 to paragraph 0A501.a:

text.zh: 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的半自动枪支受ECCN 0A506和0A507管制。
text.en: Semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less are controlled under ECCNs 0A506 and 0A507.
Technical Note to 0A501.a:

text.zh: 0A501.a所述枪支包括膛室适配0.50 BMG枪弹的枪支。
text.en: Firearms described in 0A501.a include those chambered for the .50 BMG cartridge.

text.zh: b. 口径大于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）但小于或等于0.72英寸（18.0毫米）的非自动且非半自动步枪、卡宾枪、左轮手枪或手枪。
text.en: b. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic rifles, carbines, revolvers or pistols with a caliber greater than .50 inches (12.7 mm) but less than or equal to .72 inches (18.0 mm).

text.zh: c. 为本条目.a或.b款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制商品“专门设计”的下列类型“零件”和“部件”（USML另有列举或规定，或受ECCN 0A509管制的除外）：枪管、弹巢、枪管延伸件、安装座（耳轴座）、枪机、枪机框、操作杆、导气活塞、扳机座、扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器，含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的手枪握把，以及含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”的枪托。
text.en: c. The following types of “parts” and “components” if “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or USML Category I (unless otherwise enumerated or elsewhere specified on the USML or controlled under ECCN 0A509): Barrels, cylinders, barrel extensions, mounting blocks (trunnions), bolts, bolt carriers, operating rods, gas pistons, trigger housings, triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors, pistol grips that contain fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors) and buttstocks that contain fire control “parts” or “components.”
Technical Note to 0A501.c:

text.zh: 制造进度已达到加工出弹膛或膛线阶段的枪管毛坯，受0A501.c管制。
text.en: Barrel blanks that have reached a stage in manufacturing in which they are either chambered or rifled are controlled by 0A501.c.

text.zh: d. 为本条目.a或.b款或ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”、容量为17至50发的可拆卸弹匣。
text.en: d. Detachable magazines with a capacity of 17 to 50 rounds “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or controlled by ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507.
Note 3 to paragraph 0A501.d

text.zh: 容量为16发或以下的弹匣受0A501.x管制；容量超过50发的弹匣见USML第I类。仅容纳0A505.d管制空包弹的弹匣，视其容量受0A501.d或0A501.x管制。
text.en: Magazines with a capacity of 16 rounds or less are controlled under 0A501.x; for magazines with a capacity greater than 50 rounds, see USML Category I. Magazines that hold only blank ammunition controlled under 0A505.d are controlled under 0A501.d or 0A501.x, depending on the magazine's capacity.

text.zh: e. 为本条目.a或.b款管制商品“专门设计”的机匣（机框）及“完整闭锁机构”，包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: e. Receivers (frames) and “complete breech mechanisms,” including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry.
Note 4 to 0A501.e:

text.zh: 0A501.e所指机框（机匣），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A501.e款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。
text.en: Frames (receivers) under 0A501.e refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. This paragraph 0A501.e is synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm.
Note 5 to 0A501.e:

text.zh: 为半自动枪支“专门设计”的机框（机匣）受ECCN 0A509.b或.c管制。
text.en: Frames (receivers) “specially designed” for semi-automatic firearms are controlled under ECCN 0A509.b or .c.
f. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本条目.a至.c款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML项下分类商品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定、亦不受ECCN 0A509管制的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity classified under paragraphs .a through .c of this entry, a commodity classified under ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or the USML and not elsewhere specified on the USML or CCL or controlled under ECCN 0A509.

text.zh: y. 为本ECCN、ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”，或与USML第I类防务物品通用，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的下列特定“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN, ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, or common to a defense article in USML Category I and not elsewhere specified in the USML or CCL as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor.

text.zh: y.1. 不含任何射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的枪托（包括可调式、折叠式、刀片式枪托和支撑托）、握把、护木或前托；
text.en: y.1. Stocks (including adjustable, collapsible, blades and braces), grips, handguards, or forends, that do not contain any fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors);
y.2 through y.5. [Reserved]
y.6. Bayonets; and

text.zh: y.7. 1890年至1898年制造的枪支及其仿制品。
text.en: y.7. Firearms manufactured from 1890 to 1898 and reproductions thereof.
Technical Note 1 to 0A501:

text.zh: ECCN 0A501包括不“受ITAR管辖”的“零件”和“部件”，即使它们可通用于ECCN 0A501所述枪支及“受ITAR管辖”的枪支。
text.en: ECCN 0A501 includes “parts” and “components” that are not “subject to the ITAR” even though they are common to firearms described in ECCN 0A501 and to those firearms “subject to the ITAR.”
Technical Note 2 to 0A501:

text.zh: 带有任何其他受管制“零件”或“部件”（如枪管（0A501.c）、扳机护圈（0A501.x）或枪托（0A501.y.1））的机匣，仍受0A501.e管制。
text.en: A receiver with any other controlled “part” or “component” ( e.g., a barrel (0A501.c), or trigger guard (0A501.x), or stock (0A501.y.1)) is still controlled under 0A501.e.
Technical Note 3 to 0A501:

text.zh: 空包弹射击适配器归为EAR99。该适配器是半自动和自动枪支的附属装置，为安全和正常工作而与空包弹配合使用，用于警察、军队、体育射击人员的枪械训练，也用于电影行业。
text.en: Blank firing adapters, which are attachments to semi-automatic and automatic firearms used in conjunction with blank cartridges for safety and functional reasons and used for firearm training purposes by police, military, sporting shooters, as well as in the movie industry, are designated as EAR99.
Note 6 to 0A501:

text.zh: 古董枪支（即1890年以前制造的枪支）及其仿制品、前装枪和黑火药枪（基于1937年后设计的中心发火武器设计者除外）、BB枪、铅弹气步枪、彩弹枪及所有其他气步枪，均为EAR99商品。
text.en: Antique firearms (i.e., those manufactured before 1890) and reproductions thereof, muzzle loading and black powder firearms except those designs based on centerfire weapons of a post 1937 design, BB guns, pellet rifles, paint ball, and all other air rifles are EAR99 commodities.
Note 7 to 0A501:

text.zh: 1937年后制造、口径小于20毫米、用于狩猎或体育用途、非为军事用途“专门设计”、未在USML中描述且不作为霰弹枪受ECCN 0A502管制的前装枪和黑火药枪，属于EAR99商品。
text.en: Muzzle loading and black powder firearms with a caliber less than 20 mm that were manufactured post 1937 that are used for hunting or sporting purposes that were not “specially designed” for military use and are not described on the USML nor controlled as shotguns under ECCN 0A502 are EAR99 commodities.
Note 8 to 0A501:

text.zh: 受EAR管辖的瞄准镜座或附件导轨、机械瞄具、背带环和枪托底板或后坐垫，归为EAR99。已确定这些商品不再应按ECCN 0A501视为“专门设计”。
text.en: Scope mounts or accessory rails, iron sights, sling swivels, and butt plates or recoil pads that are subject to the EAR are designated as EAR99. These commodities have been determined to no longer warrant being “specially designed” for purposes of ECCN 0A501.
Note 9 to 0A501:

text.zh: 通常成套销售和出口的枪支“零件”或“部件”套件，包括更换或维修套件，按其中管制最严格的“零件”或“部件”分类。例如，含有0A501.y和.x“零件”的套件按0A501.x套件管制，因为.x“零件”是该套件中管制最严格的“零件”。以拆解套件形式提供的完整0A501枪支，按0A501.a、.b或.y.7项下枪支管制。
text.en: A kit, including a replacement or repair kit, of firearms “parts” or “components” customarily sold and exported together takes on the classification of the most restrictive “part” or “component” that is included in the kit. For example, a kit containing 0A501.y and .x “parts,” is controlled as a 0A501.x kit because the .x “part” is the most restrictive “part” included in the kit. A complete 0A501 firearm disassembled in a kit form is controlled as a firearm under 0A501.a, .b, or .y.7.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 榴弹炮、火炮、大炮、迫击炮和无后坐力炮等现代重型武器的弹药，以及固有军事用途弹药（如预先装入弹链或弹带的弹药、无壳弹、曳光弹、带有贫铀弹丸或硬化弹尖/弹芯的弹药及带爆炸弹丸的弹药），见USML第III类。(2) 用于前装枪支的击发帽、铅丸和弹头属于EAR99物项。(3) 箭形、燃烧、曳光或爆炸性霰弹枪弹丸，见USML第III类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category III for ammunition for modern heavy weapons such as howitzers, artillery, cannon, mortars and recoilless rifles as well as inherently military ammunition types such as ammunition preassembled into links or belts, caseless ammunition, tracer ammunition, ammunition with a depleted uranium projectile or a projectile with a hardened tip or core and ammunition with an explosive projectile. (2) Percussion caps, and lead balls and bullets, for use with muzzle-loading firearms are EAR99 items. (3) See USML Category III for shotgun projectiles that are flechettes, incendiary, tracer, or explosive.

text.zh: 相关定义：‘标记弹’为非致命弹药，通常用于训练，其胶囊内装有不属于化学刺激剂的染料或涂料。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Marking rounds' are non-lethal, typically used for training purposes, and contain a dye or paint in a capsule that is not a chemical irritant.
Items:

text.zh: a. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制枪支，且未在本条目.b、.c或.d款列举或USML第III类描述的弹药。
text.en: a. Ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A506, or 0A507 or USML Category I and not enumerated in paragraph .b, .c, or .d of this entry or described in USML Category III.

text.zh: b. 鹿弹霰弹枪弹（4号、直径0.24英寸及以上，任何材料），以及仅装鹿弹或用于散布化学刺激剂的霰弹枪弹。
text.en: b. Buckshot (No. 4 .24” diameter and larger, any material) shotgun shells and shotgun shells that contain only buckshot, or are for the dispersion of chemical irritants.

text.zh: c. 不含鹿弹的霰弹枪弹（包括较低致命性弹药）；以及霰弹枪弹的“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: c. Shotgun shells (including less than lethal rounds) that do not contain buckshot; and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” of shotgun shells.

text.zh: d. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A502、0A506、0A507或0A508管制枪支，且未在USML第III类描述的空包弹。
text.en: d. Blank ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A502, 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508 and not described in USML Category III.
Technical Note to 0A505.d:

text.zh: 包括以涂料/染料为弹丸的‘标记弹’。
text.en: Includes 'marking rounds' that have paint/dye as the projectile.
e. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本ECCN管制商品或USML第III类防务物品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN or a defense article in USML Category III and not elsewhere specified on the USML or the CCL.
Note 1 to 0A505.x:

text.zh: 本条目对“零件”和“部件”的管制包括伯丹式和博克瑟式底火、金属弹壳以及标准金属弹丸，例如全金属被甲弹、铅芯弹、铜弹丸和易碎弹丸。
text.en: The controls on “parts” and “components” in this entry include Berdan and boxer primers, metallic cartridge cases, and standard metallic projectiles such as full metal jacket, lead core, copper projectiles, and frangible projectiles.
Note 2 to 0A505:

text.zh: 小于4号鹿弹的金属弹丸、未装填且未装底火的霰弹枪弹壳、霰弹枪弹托、无烟火药、‘假弹’和‘训练弹’（已连接成弹链或弹带者除外），如不含致命或非致命弹丸，归为EAR99。‘假弹’或‘训练弹’是完全惰性的弹药（即不含底火、发射药或爆炸装药），通常用于检查武器功能及人员训练。
text.en: Metal shot smaller than No. 4 Buckshot, empty and unprimed shotgun shells, shotgun wads, smokeless gunpowder, 'dummy rounds' and 'drill rounds' (unless linked or belted), not incorporating a lethal or non-lethal projectile(s) are designated EAR99. A 'dummy round' or 'drill round' is a round that is completely inert, (i.e., contains no primer, propellant, or explosive charge). It is typically used to check weapon function and for crew training.
Note 3 to 0A505:

text.zh: 含有两颗或以上、尺寸大于0.24英寸的球形弹丸/霰弹的霰弹枪弹，受0A505.b管制。
text.en: Shotgun shells that contain two or more balls/shot larger than .24-inch are controlled under 0A505.b.

List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及容量超过50发的弹匣，见USML第I类。(2) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507，但使用例如AR式或AK式机匣（机框）构成的手枪除外，此类手枪受ECCN 0A506管制。(3) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(4) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(5) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见0A501.c、.d、.x和.y。(6) 受EAR管辖的非半自动枪支（0A502霰弹枪除外）及相关商品，见ECCN 0A501。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols, excluding pistols built with, e.g., AR- or AK-style receivers (frames), which are controlled under ECCN 0A506. (3) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (4) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (5) See 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:

text.zh: a. 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的半自动中心发火（非边缘发火）步枪。
text.en: a. Semi-automatic centerfire (non-rimfire) rifles equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.

text.zh: b. 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的半自动边缘发火步枪。
text.en: b. Semi-automatic rimfire rifles equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.
Note 1 to 0A506.a and .b:

text.zh: 为本条目.a或.b项下分类商品“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，除ECCN 0A509管制者外，受ECCN 0A501.c、.d、.x或.y管制。
text.en: “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity classified under .a or .b of this entry, except those controlled under ECCN 0A509, are controlled under ECCN 0A501.c, .d, .x, or .y.
Technical Note 1 to 0A506:

text.zh: 0A506所述枪支包括膛室适配0.50 BMG枪弹的枪支。
text.en: Firearms described in 0A506 include those chambered for the .50 BMG cartridge.
Technical Note 2 to 0A506:

text.zh: 0A506所述枪支包括使用例如AR式或AK式机匣（机框）构成的手枪。
text.en: Firearms described in 0A506 include pistols built with, e.g., AR- or AK-style receivers (frames).

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (4) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (5) See ECCN 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及容量超过50发的弹匣，见USML第I类。(2) 半自动步枪见ECCN 0A506。(3) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507。(4) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受本条目.a或.c款管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(5) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A501.c、.d、.x和.y。(6) 受EAR管辖的非半自动枪支（0A502霰弹枪除外）及相关商品，见ECCN 0A501。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受本条目.a或.d款管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。(9) 类似物项见USML第I类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols. (4) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by .a or .c of this entry. (5) See ECCN 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by .a or .d of this entry. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices. (9) See USML Category I for similar items.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:

text.zh: a. USML未在其他处规定，且设计用于或具备以下功能的任何“零件”“部件”、装置、“附属装置”或“配件”：将0A501或0A502管制的非半自动枪支转换为半自动枪支，或提高0A506、0A507或0A508管制半自动枪支的射速。
text.en: a. Any “part,” “component,” device, “attachment,” or “accessory” not elsewhere specified on the USML that is designed or functions to convert a non-semi-automatic firearm controlled by 0A501 or 0A502 to semi-automatic or to accelerate the rate of fire of a semi-automatic firearm controlled by 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508.

text.zh: b. 为ECCN 0A506管制物项“专门设计”的机匣（机框），包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: b. Receivers (frames), including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for an item controlled by ECCN 0A506.

text.zh: c. 为ECCN 0A507管制物项“专门设计”的机匣（机框），包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: c. Receivers (frames), including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for an item controlled by ECCN 0A507.

text.zh: d. 用于ECCN 0A508管制商品的机匣（机框）及“专门设计”的“完整闭锁机构”。
text.en: d. Receivers (frames) and “specially designed” “complete breech mechanisms” for a commodity controlled by ECCN 0A508.
Note 1 to 0A509.b and .c:

text.zh: 0A509.b和.c所指机匣（机框），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A509.b和.c款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。就0A509.c而言，机匣（机框）包括法律上作为枪支的底架“部件”（即在现代手枪中，底架本身即为标记序列号的枪支）。
text.en: Receivers (frames) under 0A509.b and .c refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. Paragraph 0A509.b and .c are synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm. For 0A509.c, receivers (frames) includes chassis “components” that serve as the legal firearm ( i.e., with modern pistols, the chassis itself is the serialized firearm).

text.zh: 本条目不管制ECCN 1A007或ECCN 3A232所述雷管及其他物项。
text.en: This entry does not control the detonators and other items described in ECCN 1A007 or ECCN 3A232.

text.zh: c. 不受ECCN 1A984管制的烟幕手榴弹和眩晕手榴弹（如“闪光震撼弹”）。
text.en: c. Smoke hand grenades and stun hand grenades (e.g., “flashbangs”) not controlled by ECCN 1A984.

text.zh: STA：(1) 0A606.a中的任何物项不得使用STA许可证例外(c)(1)款（EAR §740.20(c)(1)），除非BIS依据§740.20(g)（9x515和“600系列”物项的STA许可证例外资格申请）确定其符合STA许可证例外资格。(2) 0A606中的任何物项不得使用STA许可证例外(c)(2)款（EAR §740.20(c)(2)）。
text.en: STA: (1) Paragraph (c)(1) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(1) of the EAR) may not be used for any item in 0A606.a, unless determined by BIS to be eligible for License Exception STA in accordance with § 740.20(g) (License Exception STA eligibility requests for 9x515 and “600 series” items). (2) Paragraph (c)(2) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(2) of the EAR) may not be used for any item in 0A606.
List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 《联邦法规》第22编第121部分第VII类所述地面车辆、其他物品、技术数据（包括软件）和服务，受《国际武器贸易条例》管辖。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) The ground vehicles, other articles, technical data (including software) and services described in 22 CFR part 121, Category VII are subject to the jurisdiction of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:

text.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类列举或以其他方式描述的地面车辆，无论有人驾驶还是无人驾驶。
text.en: a. Ground vehicles, whether manned or unmanned, “specially designed” for a military use and not enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII.
Note 1 to paragraph a:

text.zh: 就a款而言，“地面车辆”包括：(i) 1956年之前制造、1955年以后未改装，且不含可正常使用武器或经维修即可恢复使用武器的坦克和装甲车辆；(ii) 军用铁路列车，但已武装或为发射导弹“专门设计”者除外；(iii) 非装甲军用抢救车辆和其他支援车辆；(iv) 非装甲、无武装、带有0.50口径或以下枪支安装座或挂点的车辆；以及(v) 为配合USML第VII类或ECCN 0A606.a列举的其他地面车辆使用而“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类单独列举或以其他方式描述的拖车。就本注而言，“改装”不包括加装法律要求的安全设施、外观变更（如改换涂漆或调整螺栓孔位置），或加装1956年以前已有的“零件”或“部件”。
text.en: For purposes of paragraph a, “ground vehicles” include (i) tanks and armored vehicles manufactured prior to 1956 that have not been modified since 1955 and that do not contain a functional weapon or a weapon capable of becoming functional through repair; (ii) military railway trains except those that are armed or are “specially designed” to launch missiles; (iii) unarmored military recovery and other support vehicles; (iv) unarmored, unarmed vehicles with mounts or hard points for firearms of .50 caliber or less; and (v) trailers “specially designed” for use with other ground vehicles enumerated in USML Category VII or ECCN 0A606.a, and not separately enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII. For purposes of this note, the term “modified” does not include incorporation of safety features required by law, cosmetic changes (e.g., different paint or repositioning of bolt holes) or addition of “parts” or “components” available prior to 1956.
Note 2 to paragraph a:

text.zh: 为确定.a款管制，地面车辆为军事用途“专门设计”，是指其结构、电气或机械特征涉及一个或多个为军事用途“专门设计”的“部件”。这些“部件”包括：
text.en: A ground vehicle's being “specially designed” for military use for purposes of determining controls under paragraph .a. entails a structural, electrical or mechanical feature involving one or more “components” that are “specially designed” for military use. Such “components” include:

text.zh: a. “专门设计”为防弹型的充气轮胎外胎；
text.en: a. Pneumatic tire casings of a kind “specially designed” to be bullet-proof;

text.zh: b. 对重要“零件”（如油箱或驾驶室）的装甲防护；
text.en: b. Armored protection of vital “parts” (e.g., fuel tanks or vehicle cabs);

text.zh: c. 武器专用加固结构或安装座；
text.en: c. Special reinforcements or mountings for weapons;

text.zh: d. 灯火管制照明装置。
text.en: d. Black-out lighting.

text.zh: b. 下列其他地面车辆、“零件”和“部件”：
text.en: b. Other ground vehicles, “parts” and “components,” as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 由民用车辆衍生并具有以下所有特征的无武装车辆：
text.en: b.1. Unarmed vehicles that are derived from civilian vehicles and that have all of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 使用或加装反应式或电磁装甲以外的材料或“部件”，以提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护；
text.en: b.1.a. Manufactured or fitted with materials or “components” other than reactive or electromagnetic armor to provide ballistic protection equal to or better than level III (National Institute of Justice standard 0108.01, September 1985) or “equivalent standards”;

text.zh: b.1.b. 配有同时驱动前后轮的传动系统，包括为承载而增设车轮的车辆，无论该附加车轮是否驱动；
text.en: b.1.b. A transmission to provide drive to both front and rear wheels simultaneously, including those for vehicles having additional wheels for load bearing purposes whether driven or not;

text.zh: b.1.c. 车辆额定总质量（GVWR）大于4,500千克；以及
text.en: b.1.c. Gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) greater than 4,500 kg; and

text.zh: b.1.d. 为越野使用而设计或改装。
text.en: b.1.d. Designed or modified for off-road use.

text.zh: b.2. 具有以下所有特征的“零件”和“部件”：
text.en: b.2. “Parts” and “components” having all of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 为本条目.b.1款规定的车辆“专门设计”；以及
text.en: b.2.a. “Specially designed” for vehicles specified in paragraph .b.1 of this entry; and

text.zh: b.2.b. 提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护。
text.en: b.2.b. Providing ballistic protection equal to or better than level III (National Institute of Justice standard 0108.01, September 1985) or “equivalent standards”.
Note 1 to paragraph b:

text.zh: 原本受0A606.b.1管制、但含有反应式或电磁装甲的地面车辆，受USML第VII类管制。
text.en: Ground vehicles otherwise controlled by 0A606.b.1 that contain reactive or electromagnetic armor are subject to the controls of USML Category VII.
Note 2 to paragraph b:

text.zh: ECCN 0A606.b.1不管制为运输现金或贵重物品“专门设计”的民用车辆。
text.en: ECCN 0A606.b.1 does not control civilian vehicles “specially designed” for transporting money or valuables.
Note 3 to paragraph b:

text.zh: “无武装”是指未安装武器、武器安装座或为武器安装座设置的专用加固结构。
text.en: “Unarmed” means not having installed weapons, installed mountings for weapons, or special reinforcements for mounts for weapons.

text.zh: c. 用于重量超过40吨装甲车辆的风冷柴油发动机及发动机缸体。
text.en: c. Air-cooled diesel engines and engine blocks for armored vehicles that weigh more than 40 tons.

text.zh: d. 用于履带式战斗车辆的全自动无级变速器。
text.en: d. Fully automatic continuously variable transmissions for tracked combat vehicles.

text.zh: e. 为ECCN 0A606.a或USML第VII类管制地面车辆“专门设计”的深水涉渡套件。
text.en: e. Deep water fording kits “specially designed” for ground vehicles controlled by ECCN 0A606.a or USML Category VII.

text.zh: f. 未在USML第VII(g)类列举，为由USML第VII类或本ECCN列举地面车辆部署而“专门设计”的自行架设桥梁“部件”。
text.en: f. Self-launching bridge “components” not enumerated in USML Category VII(g) “specially designed” for deployment by ground vehicles enumerated in USML Category VII or this ECCN.
g. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为ECCN 0A606（0A606.b或0A606.y除外）列举或以其他方式描述的商品，或USML第VII类列举的防务物品“专门设计”，且USML其他处或0A606.y未规定的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity enumerated or otherwise described in ECCN 0A606 (other than 0A606.b or 0A606.y) or a defense article enumerated in USML Category VII and not elsewhere specified on the USML or in 0A606.y.
Note 1:

text.zh: 锻件、铸件及其他未完成制品（如挤压件和机加工坯体），如制造进度已达到可根据机械性能、材料组成、几何形状或功能明确识别为ECCN 0A606.x管制商品的阶段，受ECCN 0A606.x管制。
text.en: Forgings, castings, and other unfinished products, such as extrusions and machined bodies, that have reached a stage in manufacture where they are clearly identifiable by mechanical properties, material composition, geometry, or function as commodities controlled by ECCN 0A606.x are controlled by ECCN 0A606.x.
Note 2:

text.zh: USML第VII(g)款列举的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。ECCN 0A606.y所述“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。
text.en: “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” enumerated in USML paragraph VII(g) are subject to the controls of that paragraph. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” described in ECCN 0A606.y are subject to the controls of that paragraph.

text.zh: y. 为本ECCN（ECCN 0A606.b除外）列举或以其他方式描述的商品，或USML第VII类防务物品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的下列特定“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”：
text.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity enumerated or otherwise described in this ECCN (other than ECCN 0A606.b) or for a defense article in USML Category VII and not elsewhere specified on the USML or the CCL, as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor:

text.zh: y.1. 制动盘、转子、制动鼓、制动钳、制动缸、制动片、制动蹄、管路、软管、真空助力器及其零件；
text.en: y.1. Brake discs, rotors, drums, calipers, cylinders, pads, shoes, lines, hoses, vacuum boosters, and parts therefor;

text.zh: y.2. 交流发电机和发电机；
text.en: y.2. Alternators and generators;
y.3. Axles;
y.4. Batteries;

text.zh: y.5. 轴承（如球轴承、滚子轴承、轮毂轴承）；
text.en: y.5. Bearings (e.g., ball, roller, wheel);

text.zh: y.6. 电缆、电缆组件和连接器；
text.en: y.6. Cables, cable assembles, and connectors;
y.7. Cooling system hoses;

text.zh: y.8. 不受ECCN 1A004管制的液压、燃油、机油和空气滤清器；
text.en: y.8. Hydraulic, fuel, oil, and air filters, not controlled by ECCN 1A004;
y.9. Gaskets and o-rings;

text.zh: y.10. 液压系统软管、管件、联接件、适配器和阀门；
text.en: y.10. Hydraulic system hoses, fittings, couplings, adapters, and valves;
y.11. Latches and hinges;

text.zh: y.12. 照明系统、熔断器和“部件”；
text.en: y.12. Lighting systems, fuses, and “components;”

text.zh: y.13. 气动软管、管件、适配器、联接件和阀门；
text.en: y.13. Pneumatic hoses, fittings, adapters, couplings, and valves;

text.zh: y.14. 座椅、座椅组件、座椅支架和安全带；
text.en: y.14. Seats, seat assemblies, seat supports, and harnesses;

text.zh: y.15 轮胎，缺气保用轮胎除外；以及
text.en: y.15 Tires, except run flat; and

text.zh: y.16 车窗，装甲车辆车窗除外。
text.en: y.16 Windows, except those for armored vehicles.

text.zh: STA：0A614中的任何物项不得使用EAR中STA许可证例外(c)(2)款（§740.20(c)(2)）。
text.en: STA: Paragraph (c)(2) of License Exception STA (§ 740.20(c)(2)) of the EAR may not be used for any item in 0A614.
List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第IX类列举或以其他方式描述的防务物品及其直接相关“技术数据”（包括“软件”）“受ITAR管辖”。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”物项的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 同时通用于ECCN 0A614.a管制模拟器及USML或CCL其他处管制的被模拟系统或最终产品的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，按该被模拟系统或最终产品相应“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”所属的同一USML类别或ECCN管制。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles that are enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category IX and “technical data” (including “software”) directly related thereto are “subject to the ITAR”. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis of US-origin “600 series” items. (3) “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” that are common to a simulator controlled by ECCN 0A614.a and to a simulated system or an end item that is controlled on the USML or elsewhere on the CCL are controlled under the same USML Category or ECCN as the “parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” of the simulated system or end item.
Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：a. 为军事训练“专门设计”，且未在USML第IX类列举或以其他方式描述的“设备”。
text.en: Items: a. “Equipment” “specially designed” for military training that is not enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category IX.
Note 1 to 0A614:

text.zh: 本条目包括操作飞行训练器、雷达目标训练器、ECCN 9A610.a项下分类航空器的飞行模拟器、载人离心机、ECCN 3A611项下分类雷达的雷达训练器、军用航空器仪表飞行训练器、军事物项导航训练器、目标设备、武器装备训练器、军用无人驾驶航空器训练器、移动训练单元和地面军事行动训练“设备”。
text.en: This entry includes operational flight trainers, radar target trainers, flight simulators for aircraft classified under ECCN 9A610.a, human-rated centrifuges, radar trainers for radars classified under ECCN 3A611, instrument flight trainers for military aircraft, navigation trainers for military items, target equipment, armament trainers, military pilotless aircraft trainers, mobile training units and training “equipment” for ground military operations.
Note 2 to 0A614:

text.zh: 本条目不适用于为训练使用狩猎或体育武器而“专门设计”的“设备”。
text.en: This entry does not apply to “equipment” “specially designed” for training in the use of hunting or sporting weapons.
b. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本条目管制商品或USML第IX类列举或以其他方式描述的物品“专门设计”，且USML未在其他处规定的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by this entry or an article enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category IX, and not specified elsewhere on the USML.

List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第XIII类管制的防务物品（如依据保密信息制成的材料）及其直接相关技术数据（包括软件），受ITAR管辖。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 自携式潜水和水下游泳装置及相关商品的管制，见ECCN 8A620.f。(4) 机器人、机器人控制器和机器人末端执行器的管制，见USML第VII类及ECCN 0A606和2B007。(5) 为军事用途而与USML或“600系列”ECCN管制设备配合使用所“专门设计”的“数据库”（即参数化技术数据库），受适用于相应物项的技术数据和技术管制。(6) 为军事用途“专门设计”的核发电设备或推进设备（包括“核反应堆”）及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”的管制，见USML第VI、XIII、XV和XX类。(7) 为军用“核反应堆”“专门设计”的模拟器，受USML第IX(b)类管制。(8) 为军事用途“专门设计”的“激光”防护设备（如眼睛和传感器防护），见USML第X、XI和XII类。(9) 为USML中的防务物品或“600系列”ECCN管制商品“专门设计”的“燃料电池”，按相应最终产品所属的“600系列”ECCN管制。(10) 为卫星或航天器“专门设计”的燃料电池管制，见USML第XV类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles, such as materials made from classified information, that are controlled by USML Category XIII, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are subject to the ITAR. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) For controls on self-contained diving and underwater swimming apparatus and related commodities, see ECCN 8A620.f. (4) For controls on robots, robot controllers, and robot end-effectors, see USML Category VII and ECCNs 0A606 and 2B007. (5) “Libraries,” i.e., parametric technical databases, “specially designed” for military use with equipment controlled by the USML or a “600 series” ECCN are controlled by the technical data and technology controls pertaining to such items. (6) For controls on nuclear power generating equipment or propulsion equipment, including “nuclear reactors,” “specially designed” for military use, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, see USML Categories VI, XIII, XV, and XX. (7) Simulators “specially designed” for military “nuclear reactors” are controlled by USML Category IX(b). (8) See USML Categories X, XI and XII for “laser” protection equipment (e.g., eye and sensor protection) “specially designed” for military use. (9) “Fuel cells” “specially designed” for a defense article on the USML or a commodity controlled by a “600 series” ECCN are controlled according to the corresponding “600 series” ECCN for such end items. (10) See USML Category XV for controls on fuel cells “specially designed” for satellite or spacecraft.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:
a. [Reserved]

text.zh: b. 为军事应用“专门设计”、且不受USML第XIII类管制的隐蔽和欺骗设备，包括专用涂料、诱饵、烟幕或遮蔽设备和模拟器，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: b. Concealment and deception equipment “specially designed” for military application, including special paints, decoys, smoke or obscuration equipment and simulators, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor, not controlled by USML Category XIII.

text.zh: c. 为军事用途“专门设计”的渡船、ECCN 0A606或USML第VII类未描述的桥梁及浮桥舟。
text.en: c. Ferries, bridges not described in ECCN 0A606 or USML Category VII, and pontoons, “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: d. 为“开发”USML第IV、VI、VII和VIII类管制防务物品而“专门设计”的试验模型。
text.en: d. Test models “specially designed” for the “development” of defense articles controlled by USML Categories IV, VI, VII and VIII.
e. [Reserved]
f. “Metal embrittlement agents.”
g. through x. [Reserved]

text.zh: y. 下列其他商品，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”：
text.en: y. Other commodities as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefore:

text.zh: y.1. 为军事用途“专门设计”的施工设备，包括为由USML VIII(a)或ECCN 9A610.a管制航空器运输而“专门设计”的此类设备。
text.en: y.1. Construction equipment “specially designed” for military use, including such equipment “specially designed” for transport in aircraft controlled by USML VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a.

text.zh: y.2. 为本条目.y.1款商品“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，包括用作防护驾驶室的乘员防护套件。
text.en: y.2. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for commodities in paragraph .y.1 of this entry, including crew protection kits used as protective cabs.

text.zh: y.3. 为运输或包装防务物品或“600系列”ECCN管制物项而“专门设计”或‘改装’、未在其他处规定的ISO联运集装箱或可拆卸车辆箱体（即交换箱体）。
text.en: y.3. ISO intermodal containers or demountable vehicle bodies (i.e., swap bodies), n.e.s., “specially designed” or 'modified' for shipping or packing defense articles or items controlled by a “600 series” ECCN.
Technical Note:

text.zh: 就0A617.y.3而言，‘改装’是指任何结构、电气、机械或其他变化，使非军事物项具备相当于为军事用途“专门设计”物项的军事能力。
text.en: For the purpose of 0A617.y.3, 'modified' means any structural, electrical, mechanical, or other change that provides a non-military item with military capabilities equivalent to an item which is “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: y.4. 为军事用途“专门设计”的野战发电机。
text.en: y.4. Field generators “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: y.5. 为军事用途“专门设计”的动力控制探照灯及其控制单元，以及安装此类单元的“设备”。
text.en: y.5. Power controlled searchlights and control units therefor, “specially designed” for military use, and “equipment” mounting such units.

List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) “军事商品”如含有受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖的物项，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(2) 本款所述“军事商品”如列于《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）并位于美国境内，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(3) 无论在美国境内或境外，就受ITAR管辖防务物品的设计、开发、工程、制造、生产、组装、测试、修理、维护、改装、操作、非军事化、销毁、加工或使用向外国人提供协助（包括培训），或向外国人提供受《联邦法规》第22编§121.1管制的任何技术数据，均属国务院许可管辖。(4) 对受ITAR管辖“军事商品”开展的经纪活动（定义见《联邦法规》第22编第129部分），属国务院许可管辖。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) “Military commodities” are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if they incorporate items that are subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). (2) “Military commodities” described in this paragraph are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if such commodities are described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) and are in the United States. (3) The furnishing of assistance (including training) to foreign persons, whether in the United States or abroad, in the design, development, engineering, manufacture, production, assembly, testing, repair, maintenance, modification, operation, demilitarization, destruction, processing, or use of defense articles that are subject to the ITAR; or the furnishing to foreign persons of any technical data controlled under 22 CFR 121.1 whether in the United States or abroad are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State. (4) Brokering activities (as defined in 22 CFR 129) of “military commodities” that are subject to the ITAR are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State.

text.zh: 相关定义：“军事商品”是指《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）或《常规武器和两用物品及技术出口管制瓦森纳安排》公布的军品清单（即瓦森纳安排军品清单，WAML）所述物品、材料或物资，但不包括软件、技术、列于末三位数字为018的任何ECCN中的物项，或任何“600系列”物项。
text.en: Related Definitions: “Military commodity” or “military commodities” means an article, material or supply that is described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) or on the Munitions List that is published by the Wassenaar Arrangement on Export Controls for Conventional Arms and Dual-Use Goods and Technologies (i.e., the Wassenaar Arrangement Munitions List (WAML)), but does not include software, technology, any item listed in any ECCN for which the last three numerals are 018, or any item in the “600 series.”
Items:

text.zh: a. 在美国境外生产并位于美国境外、不受《国际武器贸易条例》（《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖，且具有以下任一特征的“军事商品”：
text.en: a. “Military commodities” produced and located outside the United States that are not subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (22 CFR parts 120-130) and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产受管制内容，该内容分类于ECCN 6A002、6A003或6A993.a（最大帧频等于或小于9 Hz，因而符合6A003.b.4注3.a的标准）；
text.en: a.1. Incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin controlled content classified under ECCNs 6A002, 6A003, or 6A993.a (having a maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz and thus meeting the criterion of Note 3.a to 6A003.b.4);

text.zh: a.2. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容（见EAR §734.4）；或
text.en: a.2. Incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content (see § 734.4 of the EAR); or

text.zh: a.3. 属于美国原产“600系列”技术或软件的直接产品（见EAR §734.9(d)）。
text.en: a.3. Are direct products of U.S.-origin “600 series” technology or software (see § 734.9(d) of the EAR).
b. [Reserved]

text.zh: 0A977水炮系统例如包括装有遥控水炮的车辆或固定站，其设计通过装甲、防碎车窗、金属防护网、防撞杆或缺气保用轮胎等特征，保护操作人员免受外部骚乱伤害。为水炮“专门设计”的部件例如包括：甲板式水炮喷嘴、水泵、储水罐、经加固或屏蔽以防弹射物损伤的摄像机和灯具、用于这些物项的升降桅杆及遥控操作系统。

Components “specially designed” for water cannons may include, for example: deck gun water nozzles, pumps, reservoirs, cameras, and lights that are hardened or shielded against projectiles, elevating masts for those items, and teleoperation systems for those items.

text.zh: ‘支撑剂’是一种固体材料，通常为经处理的砂或人造陶瓷材料，设计用于在压裂处理期间或之后保持诱导产生的水力裂缝开启。其加入‘压裂液’中；压裂液的组成可随压裂类型变化，可以凝胶、泡沫或滑溜水为基础。
text.en: A 'proppant' is a solid material, typically treated sand or man-made ceramic materials, designed to keep an induced hydraulic fracture open, during or following a fracturing treatment. It is added to a 'fracking fluid' which may vary in composition depending on the type of fracturing used, and can be gel, foam or slickwater-based.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1A202、1C010、1C210、9A010和9A110。(3) 为导弹应用“专门设计”的“复合材料”结构（包括“专门设计”的子系统、“零件”和“部件”），受ECCN 9A110管制。(4) 为分离铀同位素而“专门设计”或制备的“复合材料”结构或层压制品，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1A202, 1C010, 1C210, 9A010, and 9A110. (3) “Composite” structures “specially designed” for missile applications (including “specially designed” subsystems, “parts,” and “components”) are controlled by ECCN 9A110. (4) “Composite” structures or laminates “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).
Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: a. 由以下任一种材料制成：
text.en: a. Made from any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 有机“基体”及1C010.c或1C010.d规定的“纤维或丝状材料”；或
text.en: a.1. An organic “matrix” and “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.c or 1C010.d; or

text.zh: a.2. 1C010.e规定的预浸料或预成型件；
text.en: a.2. Prepregs or preforms specified by 1C010.e;

text.zh: b. 由金属或碳“基体”及以下任一种材料制成：
text.en: b. Made from a metal or carbon “matrix”, and any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 具有以下所有特征的碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: b.1. Carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” having all of the following:
b.1.a. A “specific modulus” exceeding 10.15 x 10^{6} m; and
b.1.b. A “specific tensile strength” exceeding 17.7 x 10^{4} m; or
b.2. Materials controlled by 1C010.c.
Note 1:

text.zh: 1A002不管制由环氧树脂浸渍碳“纤维或丝状材料”制成、用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品，并具有以下所有特征的“复合材料”结构或层压制品：
text.en: 1A002 does not control “composite” structures or laminates made from epoxy resin impregnated carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:
a. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2};

text.zh: b. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
text.en: b. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and
c. A width exceeding 15 mm.
Note 2:

text.zh: 1A002不管制为以下民用应用“专门设计”的半成品：
text.en: 1A002 does not control semi-finished items, “specially designed” for civilian applications as follows:
a. Sporting goods;
b. Automotive industry;
c. Machine tool industry;
d. Medical applications.
Note 3:

text.zh: 1A002.b.1不适用于所含交织丝的维度最多为二维，且为以下应用“专门设计”的半成品：
text.en: 1A002.b.1 does not apply to semi-finished items containing a maximum of two dimensions of interwoven filaments and “specially designed” for applications as follows:

text.zh: a. 用于金属回火的金属热处理炉；
text.en: a. Metal heat-treatment furnaces for tempering metals;

text.zh: b. 硅单晶锭生产设备。
text.en: b. Silicon boule production equipment.
Note 4:

text.zh: 1A002不适用于为特定应用“专门设计”的成品。
text.en: 1A002 does not apply to finished items “specially designed” for a specific application.
Note 5:

text.zh: 1A002.b.1不适用于经机械切碎、研磨或切断且长度为25.0毫米或以下的碳“纤维或丝状材料”。
text.en: 1A002.b.1 does not apply to mechanically chopped, milled, or cut carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” 25.0 mm or less in length.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 见ECCN 1A995、2B351和2B352。(2) 为使设备能够执行1A004.c项（核、生物和化学（NBC）探测系统）管制设备的功能而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”，见ECCN 1D003。(3) 为使设备能够执行1A004.c（核、生物和化学（NBC）探测系统）管制设备的功能而“专门设计”或改装的控制数据库（参数化技术数据库），见ECCN 1E002.g。(4) 专为军事应用设计、开发、改装、配置或适配的化学和生物防护及探测设备“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分，包括USML第XIV(f)类）；装有该类管制“零件”或“部件”的商业设备亦同。但用于国内应急准备的个人防护装置如集成USML第XIV(f)(4)类所列“部件”和“零件”，且这些“零件”或“部件”是装置不可分割的组成部分、不能从装置分离，并且若更换就会损害装置有效性，则该设备按ECCN 1A004受商务部出口许可管辖。(5) 本条目不管制装入本条目所列设备的放射性核素；此类材料受核管理委员会许可管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1A995, 2B351, and 2B352. (2) See ECCN 1D003 for “software” “specially designed” or modified to enable equipment to perform the functions of equipment controlled under section 1A004.c (Nuclear, biological, and chemical (NBC) detection systems). (3) See ECCN 1E002.g for control libraries (parametric technical databases) “specially designed” or modified to enable equipment to perform the functions of equipment controlled under 1A004.c (Nuclear, biological, and chemical (NBC) detection systems). (4) Chemical and biological protective and detection equipment specifically designed, developed, modified, configured, or adapted for military applications is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130, including USML Category XIV(f)), as is commercial equipment that incorporates “parts” or “components” controlled under that category except for domestic preparedness devices for individual protection that integrate “components” and “parts” identified in USML Category XIV(f)(4) when such “parts” or “components” are: Integral to the device; inseparable from the device; and incapable of replacement without compromising the effectiveness of the device, in which case the equipment is subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of Commerce under ECCN 1A004. (5) This entry does not control radionuclides incorporated in equipment listed in this entry—such materials are subject to the licensing jurisdiction of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (See 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) ‘生物战剂’是指经选择或改性（例如改变纯度、储存寿命、毒力、散布特性或抗紫外线辐射能力），以造成人或动物伤亡、降低设备性能或损害作物或环境的病原体或毒素。(2) ‘防暴剂’是指在预期防暴使用条件下，迅速使人产生感觉刺激或丧失行动能力的生理作用，且停止接触后该作用在短时间内消失的物质。（催泪剂属于‘防暴剂’的一部分。）
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) 'Biological agents' means: pathogens or toxins, selected or modified (such as altering purity, shelf life, virulence, dissemination characteristics, or resistance to UV radiation) to produce casualties in humans or animals, degrade equipment or damage crops or the environment. (2) 'Riot control agents' are substances which, under the expected conditions of use for riot control purposes, produce rapidly in humans sensory irritation or disabling physical effects which disappear within a short time following termination of exposure. (Tear gases are a subset of 'riot control agents.')
Items:

text.zh: a. 为防御以下任一种战剂或材料而设计或改装的全面罩、滤毒罐及其去污设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: a. Full face masks, filter canisters and decontamination equipment therefor, designed or modified for defense against any of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:
Note:

text.zh: 1A004.a包括为防御1A004.a所列战剂或材料而设计或改装的电动送风过滤式呼吸器（PAPR）。
text.en: 1A004.a includes Powered Air Purifying Respirators (PAPR) that are designed or modified for defense against agents or materials, listed in 1A004.a.
Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 1A004.a:
1. Full face masks are also known as gas masks.
2. Filter canisters include filter cartridges.
a.1. 'Biological agents';
a.2. 'Radioactive materials';
a.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents; or
a.4. 'Riot control agents', as follows:

text.zh: a.4.a. α-溴苯乙腈（溴苄基氰）（CA）（CAS 5798-79-8）；
text.en: a.4.a. α-Bromobenzeneacetonitrile, (Bromobenzyl cyanide) (CA) (CAS 5798-79-8);

text.zh: a.4.b. [(2-氯苯基)亚甲基]丙二腈（邻氯苯亚甲基丙二腈）（CS）（CAS 2698-41-1）；
text.en: a.4.b. [(2-chlorophenyl) methylene] propanedinitrile, (o-Chlorobenzylidenemalononitrile) (CS) (CAS 2698-41-1);

text.zh: a.4.c. 2-氯-1-苯基乙酮、苯甲酰甲基氯（ω-氯苯乙酮）（CN）（CAS 532-27-4）；
text.en: a.4.c. 2-Chloro-1-phenylethanone, Phenylacyl chloride (ω-chloroacetophenone) (CN) (CAS 532-27-4);
a.4.d. Dibenz-(b,f)-1,4-oxazephine, (CR) (CAS 257-07-8);

text.zh: a.4.e. 10-氯-5,10-二氢吩砒嗪（氯化吩砒嗪）（亚当氏剂）（DM）（CAS 578-94-9）；
text.en: a.4.e. 10-Chloro-5, 10-dihydrophenarsazine, (Phenarsazine chloride), (Adamsite), (DM) (CAS 578-94-9);
a.4.f. N-Nonanoylmorpholine, (MPA) (CAS 5299-64-9);

text.zh: b. 为防御以下任一种战剂或材料而“专门设计”或改装的防护服、手套和鞋：
text.en: b. Protective suits, gloves and shoes, “specially designed” or modified for defense against any of the following:
b.1. 'Biological agents';
b.2. 'Radioactive materials'; or
b.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents;

text.zh: c. 为探测或识别以下任一种战剂或材料而“专门设计”或改装的探测系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: c. Detection systems, “specially designed” or modified for detection or identification of any of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:
c.1. 'Biological agents';
c.2. 'Radioactive materials'; or
c.3. Chemical warfare (CW) agents;

text.zh: d. 设计用于自动探测或识别“炸药”（列于第1类末尾附件）残留物，并采用‘痕量探测’技术（如表面声波、离子迁移谱、差分迁移谱、质谱）的电子设备。
text.en: d. Electronic equipment designed for automatically detecting or identifying the presence of “explosives” (as listed in the annex at the end of Category 1) residues and utilizing 'trace detection' techniques (e.g., surface acoustic wave, ion mobility spectrometry, differential mobility spectrometry, mass spectrometry).
Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1A004.d而言，‘痕量探测’定义为能够探测浓度低于1 ppm的蒸气或质量低于1毫克的固体或液体。
text.en: For the purposes of 1A004.d, 'trace detection' is defined as the capability to detect less than 1 ppm vapor, or 1 mg solid or liquid.
Note 1:

text.zh: 1A004.d不适用于为实验室使用而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: 1A004.d does not apply to equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use.

text.zh: 注2：1A004.d不适用于非接触式步行通过安检门。
text.en: Note 2: 1A004.d does not apply to non-contact walk-through security portals.
Note: 1A004 does not control:

text.zh: a. 个人辐射监测剂量计；
text.en: a. Personal radiation monitoring dosimeters;

text.zh: b. 设计或功能仅限于防护住宅安全或民用行业特有危险的职业健康或安全设备，包括：
text.en: b. Occupational health or safety equipment limited by design or function to protect against hazards specific to residential safety or civil industries, including:
1. Mining;
2. Quarrying;
3. Agriculture;
4. Pharmaceutical;
5. Medical;
6. Veterinary;
7. Environmental;
8. Waste management;
9. Food industry.
Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 1A004包括已被‘认定’、通过国家标准测试或以其他方式证明能够有效探测或防御‘放射性材料’、‘生物战剂’、化学战剂、‘模拟剂’或“防暴剂”的设备和“部件”，即使这些设备或“部件”用于采矿、采石、农业、制药、医疗、兽医、环境、废物管理或食品工业等民用行业。
text.en: 1. 1A004 includes equipment, “components” that have been 'identified,' successfully tested to national standards or otherwise proven effective, for the detection of or defense against 'radioactive materials' 'biological agents,' chemical warfare agents, 'simulants' or “riot control agents,” even if such equipment or “components” are used in civil industries such as mining, quarrying, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, medical, veterinary, environmental, waste management, or the food industry.

text.zh: 2. ‘模拟剂’：在训练、研究、测试或评估中替代有毒战剂（化学或生物）的物质或材料。
text.en: 2. 'Simulant': A substance or material that is used in place of toxic agent (chemical or biological) in training, research, testing or evaluation.

text.zh: 3. 就1A004而言，‘放射性材料’是指经选择或改性，以提高其造成人或动物伤亡、降低设备性能或损害作物或环境的效力的材料。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 1A004, 'radioactive materials' are those selected or modified to increase their effectiveness in producing casualties in humans or animals, degrading equipment or damaging crops or the environment.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 提供NIJ IV型或以上防护的防弹背心（防弹衣）“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1第X(a)类）。(2) 按军事标准或规格制造、提供等于或低于NIJ III级或“同等标准”防护的软质防弹衣和防护服，分类于ECCN 1A613.d.1。(3) 提供NIJ III级或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板，分类于ECCN 1A613.d.2。(4) 警用头盔和盾牌分类于ECCN 0A979。(5) 为军事应用“专门设计”、未受USML或CCL其他处管制的其他个人防护“设备”，分类于ECCN 1A613.e。(6) 用于制造防弹衣的“纤维或丝状材料”，见ECCN 1C010。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Bulletproof and bullet resistant vests (body armor) providing NIJ Type IV protection or greater are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR 121.1 Category X(a)). (2) Soft body armor and protective garments manufactured to military standards or specifications that provide protection equal to or less than NIJ level III or “equivalent standards” are classified under ECCN 1A613.d.1. (3) Hard armor plates providing NIJ level III or “equivalent standard” ballistic protection are classified under ECCN 1A613.d.2. (4) Police helmets and shields are classified under ECCN 0A979. (5) Other personal protective “equipment” “specially designed” for military applications not controlled by the USML or elsewhere in the CCL is classified under ECCN 1A613.e. (6) For “fibrous or filamentary materials” used in the manufacture of body armor, see ECCN 1C010.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:

text.zh: a. 非按军事标准、规格或其等效标准制造的软质防弹衣，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”；
text.en: a. Soft body armor not manufactured to military standards or specifications, or to their equivalents, and “specially designed” “components” therefor;

text.zh: b. 提供低于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板。
text.en: b. Hard body armor plates that provide ballistic protection less than NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”.
Notes to ECCN 1A005:

text.zh: 1. 防弹衣随使用者携带、供其本人个人防护时，本条目不予管制。
text.en: 1. This entry does not control body armor when accompanying its user for the user's own personal protection.

text.zh: 2. 本条目不管制设计为仅对非军用爆炸装置的破片和爆炸冲击同时提供正面防护的防弹衣。
text.en: 2. This entry does not control body armor designed to provide frontal protection only from both fragment and blast from non-military explosive devices.

text.zh: 3. 本条目不适用于设计为仅防护刀、尖刺、针或钝器伤害的防护衣。
text.en: 3. This entry does not apply to body armor designed to provide protection only from knife, spike, needle or blunt trauma.

Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1A006.b而言，‘破坏器’是为通过发射液体、固体或易碎弹丸阻止爆炸装置运作而“专门设计”的装置。
text.en: For the purposes of 1A006.b 'disruptors' are devices “specially designed” for the purpose of preventing the operation of an explosive device by projecting a liquid, solid or frangible projectile.
Note:

text.zh: 设备随其操作人员携带时，1A006不适用。
text.en: 1A006 does not apply to equipment when accompanying its operator.

text.zh: 相关管制：为军事用途“专门设计”的猛炸药及相关设备“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。本条目不管制仅使用叠氮化铅等起爆药的雷管。另见ECCN 0A604、3A229和3A232。“开发”和“生产”技术管制见1E001，“使用”技术管制见1E201。
text.en: Related Controls: High explosives and related equipment “specially designed” for military use are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). This entry does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. See also ECCNs 0A604, 3A229, and 3A232. See 1E001 for “development” and “production” technology controls, and 1E201 for “use” technology controls.
Related Definitions: N/A
Items:

text.zh: a. 设计用于驱动1A007.b规定爆炸雷管的雷管起爆装置；
text.en: a. Explosive detonator firing sets designed to drive explosive detonators specified by 1A007.b;

text.zh: b. 下列电驱动爆炸雷管：
text.en: b. Electrically driven explosive detonators as follows:
b.1. Exploding bridge (EB);
b.2. Exploding bridge wire (EBW);
b.3. Slapper;
b.4. Exploding foil initiators (EFI).
Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. “起爆器”或“点火器”一词有时用于替代“雷管”。
text.en: 1. The word initiator or igniter is sometimes used in place of the word detonator.

text.zh: 2. 就1A007.b而言，所涉雷管均利用一个微小电导体（桥、桥丝或箔），当快速大电流电脉冲通过时，该导体爆炸性气化。在非冲击片型中，爆炸导体使与其接触的猛炸药材料（如PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）发生化学爆轰。在冲击片雷管中，电导体的爆炸性气化驱动飞片或冲击片穿过间隙，冲击片撞击炸药从而引发化学爆轰。某些设计中的冲击片由磁力驱动。“爆炸箔雷管”一词可指EB型或冲击片型雷管。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 1A007.b, the detonators of concern all utilize a small electrical conductor (bridge, bridge wire, or foil) that explosively vaporizes when a fast, high-current electrical pulse is passed through it. In non slapper types, the exploding conductor starts a chemical detonation in a contacting high explosive material such as PETN (pentaerythritoltetranitrate). In slapper detonators, the explosive vaporization of the electrical conductor drives a flyer or slapper across a gap, and the impact of the slapper on an explosive starts a chemical detonation. The slapper in some designs is driven by magnetic force. The term exploding foil detonator may refer to either an EB or a slapper-type detonator.
